about_the_game:
A Late-Night Show Turns Into a Hunt for the Truth. You finally landed your first real gig—a late-night radio show in a small backwater town. It’s supposed to be your big break, but when strange cosmic events begin to unfold, your routine broadcast quickly becomes a battle for survival. 

Social Deduction Meets Survival Horror



 Your only connection to the outside world is your callers—but can you trust them?

  • Listen carefully. Some want to help, others want to lead you astray.

  • Decipher their motives. Are they real fans or something far more sinister?

  • Survive the night. Every decision matters.

Keep the Show Running – No Matter What

It’s just you, your phone lines, and your studio equipment—but something else is out there.

  • Manage your broadcast. Keep the music flowing and the signal alive.

  • Fend off unseen horrors. Strange entities lurk in the darkness.

  • Piece together the mystery. The truth is hidden between the static.

Will you keep the airwaves alive, or will the night consume you?

content_descriptors.notes: Players will encounter horror elements throughout the game including but not limited to acts of violence/implied acts of violence against others.

name: Strange Waveforms

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce 1650 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core I7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia Geforce 2060 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Strange Waveforms is a survival horror game where you take on the role of a late-night DJ. Combine social deduction with survival horror to determine who among your callers can be trusted – and who means you harm. Figure out the truth, survive the night, and keep the broadcast running at all costs.
